label: Late in episode, rises at D1 after reaching S2 (most after a1-S2-unrewarded) and at D2 after choosing a1.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * np.exp(ep_trial/15)
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * np.exp(ep_trial/12) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/12) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.exp(ep_trial/12) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/12) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * np.exp(ep_trial/12) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/12) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S2) * np.exp(ep_trial/12) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action==1) * np.exp(ep_trial/12)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 33 grows roughly exponentially with trial in the episode (timing alone R^2 0.69). Beyond timing, its deviations scale with that same growth: at D1 it is higher when the previous trial reached S2 (and lower after S1), with the largest boost after a1->S2 rare unrewarded; at D2 it is higher when this trial chose a1 (just observed) and lower for a2. Multiplying the indicators by exp(ep_trial/15) is essential (flat indicators reach only ~0.15). Previous reward on its own adds nothing; only its interaction with S2 matters. The free fit adds GO after rewarded trials, D2 state S1 versus S2, D2 belief log-odds and D1 previous action (dev 0.34 vs 0.29 short). Remaining error is mostly per-episode overall scale late in the episode, which no trial-history cue captures. Uses observed variables only (action at D2 has already been taken).
